title: Pseudomonas Isolation Agar Preparation
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vcre2v6
materials: Leave plates in laminar hood until agar sets.

steps.title: Prepare Agar Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the agar powder, glycerol, and water in a bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 45.03 g Pseudomonas isolation agar and 20 mL of 100% glycerol per 980 mL of water.

steps.title: Dissolve Powder
steps.instruction: Mix the solution thoroughly by inverting the bottle several times until the powder is dissolved.

steps.title: Sterilize Media
steps.instruction: Autoclave the mixture on a liquid cycle for 20 min at 15 psi (1.05 kg/cm2).

steps.title: Pour Plates
steps.instruction: While the media is still liquid, pour the agar into plates within a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Store Plates
steps.instruction: Once the agar has set, invert the plates and store them in an air tight bag at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Plates for Use
steps.instruction: Equilibrate plates to room temperature before use.

substeps.instruction: Remove plates from 4 °C at least 1 h before use.
Wipe lids dry with Kimwipe to prevent condensation from dropping onto the agar surface.
Store plates inverted while at room temperature.
